_comment: Recette R-535 (2026-10-01): package references the launcher's outdated-NuGet guard does not count, each with its reason and its end condition. An exception is never permanent: once the solution targets untilTargetFramework or later, the guard reports it as expired and counts the package again, so the pin is revisited instead of forgotten.

exceptions.reason: Pinned to the compiler of the first .NET 10 SDK so the in-house analyzers load in the pinned SDK's compiler (Directory.Packages.props).
Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi 10.0.x accepts only Microsoft.OpenApi [2.12.0, 3.0.0); 3.x breaks its source generator (CS0200). Only ASP.NET Core 11 accepts 3.x.
